## Problem and result

Link requirement/acceptance IDs; describe observable before/after behavior.

## Validation

Commands, results, meaningful edge cases. Attach UI evidence for layout changes.

## Data and operations

Migration compatibility, ownership/access changes, rollout/rollback. Explicitly say when not applicable.

## Agent handoff

Update traceability and docs/worklog.md. State unresolved assumptions; do not claim untested work passed.
